card.name: Hours and day within a single day
card.fires_on: Short time-of-day or duration words such as hours, day, minutes, hour, and linking words like on or before right after them, when the text is placing an event within the same day.

modes.label: Short time spans
modes.description: Hours, minutes or hour after a number or adjective, describing how long or how soon before an event.
modes.example: a respectable score within 20 per cent of the able-bodied users after just 10<< minutes>> of using the device for the first time

modes.label: Same-day references
modes.description: The word day or a linking word after Today, Thursday or Earlier in the, pointing to a specific day.
modes.example: “20 seconds…” the voice called again. Earlier in the<< day>>, this group had traveled out to Aberdeen

card.writes: It pushes the model toward same-day words like 当天, 下午 and 第二天 and away from longer spans such as half-year or season.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text pins something to a particular day or a few hours, not to a long period.
